blurb: Guests fish in the Pacific Ocean off the Oregon coast for species including salmon, halibut, lingcod, rockfish, and albacore tuna. Trips are guided by experienced captains with all gear, bait, and tackle provided except fishing licenses. Trips vary in duration and target species, with options for crabbing and combo fishing experiences.
